summary: Rename to Sproutly + withered-sapling dead tree verified end-to-end. Backend rebrand ('Sproutly API' at GET /api/, friends/me returns 'sproutly:friend:<CODE>', POST /api/friends/requests accepts new+legacy+bare payloads) all pass (8/8 pytest). Frontend: no 'SproutGoals' string anywhere in login/garden/goals/timer/friends/profile tabs, login screen title reads 'Sproutly'. Dead-tree state (plant_f950c13f4790, is_dead=true) renders testID dead-tree-svg with dead-tree-title, revive-button and replant-button all visible and no SVG errors in console. Alive tree renders normally (testID tree-svg) after DB restore. 5 tabs load. expo-router scheme change didn't break navigation. Plant restored to is_dead=false, died_at=null; user has no last_revive_month/last_freeze_claim_month; all settings true. One minor UI concern: dead-tree-svg element measures 340x944px in the DOM (viewBox 360x1000 scaled to width 340), so the actual small sapling (~230px tall stem) sits at the bottom of a ~944px-tall container leaving a large empty sky/ground pad above it. Sapling shape (stem, drooping shoots, wilted grey/brown leaves, cracked soil) is correct but visually looks lost inside the oversized canvas.

ui_bugs.issue: SVG canvas is 340x944px but the withered sapling only occupies ~230px near the bottom, leaving a large empty grey sky area above. Consider reducing the SVG viewBox height (e.g. H≈420, GY≈320) or clipping so the rendered container matches the small-sapling intent. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TreeView.tsx:320-383 (H=1000, GY=880).

issues: Tree canvas card below the memorial info card contains a lot of empty light-yellow/grey space around the small sapling because DeadTree still uses the full-tree viewBox (1000 tall). Consider reducing canvas height when isDead=true so the sapling feels intentionally small, not lost.
